title: Smiling Girl in Pigtails by House Siding, 1962 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful outdoor snapshot from April 1962 capturing a young girl, possibly named Sandy, sporting cheerful pigtails and a bright smile. She wears a patterned short-sleeved blouse with a pointed hem paired with tailored shorts, standing beside the clapboard siding of a house with a wire garden fence and lush foliage in the background. Typical of mid-century American suburban family snapshots, the photo is bordered with deckled edges and date-stamped in the top margin.
